IS 7200 : Part 2 : 1975 Presentation of statistical data:Part 2 Diagrammatic representation of dataUDC 519.2 (084.2)MSD 3Reaffirmed 20211. Scope1.1 This standard (Part II) deals with the diagrammatic representation of data in the form of line graphs, bar charts, pie charts, symbol charts and statistical maps. The colouring technique is outside the scope of this standard.
